BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

5. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

6. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

7. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

10. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

11. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
